name: Craftsman's Writ: Green Iron Gauntlets
summary: MacKinley’s writ asks you to bring him Green Iron Gauntlets. The transferable note includes delivery and payment details.

sections.title: A Written Order
sections.body: The faded writ names Green Iron Gauntlets and gives a delivery place and payment. You need the writ with you to complete the exchange. MacKinley waits for the goods, though his greeting hints that something is amiss.

sections.title: At the Exchange
sections.body: MacKinley says he wanted green iron knuckles, not gauntlets. He accepts the gauntlets while he waits for a replacement, then pays you less than you expected.

faq.answer: The writ requests one pair of Green Iron Gauntlets, though MacKinley says he meant to ask for green iron knuckles.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the gauntlets?
faq.answer: The writ gives a delivery location, marked on your map.

faq.q: Do I need the writ with me?
faq.answer: Yes. The writ must be in your possession to complete the exchange.

faq.q: What does the writ say about payment?
faq.answer: The note includes information about payment, but gives no amount in its text.

faq.q: Can someone else carry the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

attribution: In-game quest text: Craftsman's Writ: Green Iron Gauntlets
